summary: SBIN Depth across a dropped socket: both feeds are sent again on the new connection, and its first quote is not paired with the book from before the outage; the new session's book is.

deviations.reason: Tradejini sends the trade time in epoch seconds; the web formats it with the server's local time zone into a text such as "2025-11-05 14:25:31" (nxtradstream.py datefmt) and sends that as ltt, where feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends epoch ms, and leaves ltt out when Tradejini sent no trade time, where the web sends null (Quote, Depth) or "" (LTP).
The web sends Tradejini's upper circuit limit (L1 ucl) on Depth; the desktop decodes it (streaming.rs L1::ucl) but the common carrier drops it.
deviations.ref: tradejini_adapter.py:852; audit appendix 'fields dropped by the common carrier' (lane wire)

deviations.reason: As upper_circuit, for the lower limit (L1 lcl).
deviations.ref: tradejini_adapter.py:853; audit appendix 'fields dropped by the common carrier' (lane wire)

deviations.reason: The web also sends the trade time as last_trade_time (the same local-time text as its ltt, a web defect); the desktop sends no last_trade_time for Tradejini. Phase B: the dialect alias in epoch ms beside ltt, as Samco, 5paisa and mStock have it (feed::dialect, lane wire); the value then stays a declared web defect.

The desktop sends a non-index instrument's change under the canonical price_change and price_change_percent as well (feed/dialect/names.rs instrument_change, docs/port/market-data-frames.md 'Change and open interest'); the web's Tradejini adapter sends it only as change, change_percent and percent_change. Follows the web adapter once wire's per-broker switch covers instruments (lead to confirm; ruling 4 named the index).

An equity's L1 carries no OI; the web sends oi 0 in Depth, and in a Quote (message.get("OI", 0)), an invented zero. The desktop leaves out a field the stream did not carry (web openalgo#2376; rules.md: no invented data).
